description: Source code for managing icDevice objects, including creation, cloning, serialization to JSON, deserialization from JSON, printing, and cleanup functions within a device management SDK.

methods.name: deviceDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an icDevice object and its internal components.

methods.name: devicePrint
methods.description: Prints details of an icDevice object with a specified prefix for indentation.

methods.name: deviceClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an icDevice object.

methods.name: deviceToJSON
methods.description: Serializes an icDevice object into a cJSON JSON representation.

methods.name: deviceGetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific metadata key from an icDevice.

methods.name: deviceFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into an icDevice object.
